title: KiCad Engine Microcontroller Family Content Generator Config

vendor.description: Stable vendor folder name, for example STMICRO_STM32, ESPRESSIF, MICROCHIP_PIC, MICROCHIP_AVR, NORDIC.

family.description: Stable family folder/name, for example STM32F0, STM32F4, ESP32_S3, PIC18, NRF52.

representative_part.description: Representative part used to create part-level stub files. This is not treated as verified.

output_folder.description: Optional explicit output folder. If omitted, the generator writes under 06_DATASHEETS/01_MICROCONTROLLERS/<vendor>/<family>.

source_links.description: Optional link-only seed sources. No downloads are performed.

notes.default: Link-only seed source. Review before use.

notes.description: Optional generator notes to include in README output.
